verification.check: TotalPrice differs from Quantity x UnitPrice

observations: Coupons are not reflected in TotalPrice: it equals Quantity x UnitPrice on all 1,200 rows, so discount and shipping effects cannot be measured from this file.
497 orders (41.4%) are Cancelled or Returned but still carry a TotalPrice. Filter on OrderStatus before calculating revenue.
487 Cancelled or Pending orders have a TrackingNumber, which is unusual for orders that never shipped. Kept as supplied; confirm with the data owner.
UnitPrice varies widely inside a single product (Laptop: 18.20 to 699.93), so it is not a stable catalogue price. Kept as supplied.
8 TotalPrice values fall outside the 1.5 x IQR fence. They are valid high-quantity, high-price orders and were retained.
11 CustomerIDs appear on more than one order. These are repeat customers with different OrderIDs, not duplicates, and were retained.
